modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose the onboard experience for your route, then compare seat selection and flexibility within that fare. Mint availability depends on the flight.

main.value: JetBlue's Main experience includes seatback entertainment, Fly-Fi connectivity, and complimentary snacks and drinks. Connectivity and entertainment availability can vary by coverage area.

evenmore.value: EvenMore adds extra legroom near the front, Group 2 boarding and dedicated overhead space. Priority security is available at participating airports; onboard food and drink perks depend on the flight.

mint.value: Mint offers lie-flat seats or suites on all transatlantic flights and selected coast-to-coast, Caribbean and Latin America routes. Check the aircraft and seat map for the configuration on your flight.

bluefirst_launch.value: BlueFirst is announced for rollout later in 2026 on flights without Mint. Do not assume it is available unless it appears for your chosen flight.

modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: All fares include a cabin bag and a personal item.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Carry-on bags must fit within 22 x 14 x 9 inches, including handles and wheels.

personal_item.value: Personal items must fit under the seat and measure no more than 17 x 13 x 8 inches.

carryon_weight.value: JetBlue publishes no carry-on weight limit; you must be able to lift your bag into the overhead bin if assistance is unavailable.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Bag prices vary by route, fare, travel dates and when you pay. Use the booking's allowance before purchasing extras.

checked_bag_fees.value: Base fares generally charge for checked bags. Route-specific exceptions and eligible loyalty or card benefits can apply.

mint_baggage.value: Mint and Mint Flex include two checked bags, each up to 70 lb / 32 kg.

prepay_bags.value: Adding the first two bags more than 24 hours before departure can save up to USD 10 per bag.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: JetBlue's current fee page lists Main Base. Older bookings may use Blue Basic terminology; follow the conditions attached to your ticket.

seat_selection.value: Main Base charges for choosing a seat; otherwise a seat is assigned before departure.

change_cancel_fees.value: Main Base and EvenMore Base have a USD 150 per-person change or cancellation fee; fare differences also apply to changes.

included_carryon.value: Even the lowest fare includes one carry-on and one personal item within JetBlue's size limits.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Start with Flight Tracker and Manage Trips to see your status, replacement itinerary and available choices.

cancelled_flight.value: JetBlue may automatically rebook a cancelled flight. Review the new itinerary in Manage Trips before choosing another option.

significant_disruption.value: JetBlue lists arrival delays of at least three hours domestically or six hours internationally among qualifying disruptions. Airport changes, extra connections and certain other itinerary changes can also qualify.

refund_or_rebooking.value: For qualifying disruptions, review free rebooking or cancellation for a refund to the original payment method, including eligible extras. Cancel online or contact JetBlue before departure if choosing a refund.

delayed_departure.value: Continue planning around the original departure time: an estimated delay can shorten.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Online check-in does not replace the airport bag-drop deadline or international document checks.

online_checkin.value: Online and app check-in open 24 hours before departure.

domestic_bag_drop.value: Domestic bag drop closes 45 minutes before departure, or 60 minutes for flights from the U.S. Virgin Islands.

international_cutoff.value: International check-in and bag drop require at least 60 minutes; Dublin requires at least 80 minutes.

without_checked_bags.value: Domestic boarding-pass cutoffs vary: 45 minutes at listed major airports, 60 minutes from the U.S. Virgin Islands and 30 minutes at other airports. Check your departure airport's listing.

modules.title: Contact and the small print
modules.lede: Use JetBlue's official contact and legal pages for support and your ticket conditions.
